title: 第3章 出名要趁早
content_zh:
“那得等你当上师级干部！”王爱梅甩了甩筷子上的水，“咱家的条件比上不足，但比下有余。你好好当你的兵，别想什么歪门邪道。你上次救人立功，你爸可高兴了，逢人就说。”

    刘振国走进来笑着说道：“好像你没出去嚷嚷似的，你妈可比我嗓门大。”

    “吃你的饭！”王爱梅瞪了刘振国一眼，大声地说道。

    中午，王爱梅做了面条、土豆鸡蛋卤、还有从六必居买的酱菜。卤，也就是浇头。吃面的时候，把卤浇到面条上，搅一搅就可以直接吃了。

    他们来到了燕京，可吃饭的习惯一直没有变。

    刘振国夸赞了几句好吃，捧的王爱梅心花怒放，接着询问刘济民，最近的学业情况。

    提起学习，刘振国就头疼，他知道自家这小子学医完全是赶鸭子上架，关键是没天赋。

    “唉，要是实在不行，回到部队后，就跟上级提一提，直接进入作战连队。医生学艺不精，那可是要出大事的。”刘振国无奈地说道，心想当初要是能被送到水利类大学就好了，还能子承父业。

    卫生员当起来比较简单，但军医那可就不能滥竽充数了。

    “还是要留在部队，回到地方太难找工作了。最近不少知青回城，加上本身就没工作的青年太多，不好安排啊！上级有意试行顶岗制度，允许退休职工的一名子女接班，还没开始试行，一些家里都已经吵翻天了。集体单位都打破了脑袋往里面进，这还是回来一部分，要是全回来了，这居委会的工作就不好做了。”

    王爱梅皱着眉头说道，眼里满是担忧。大量的年轻人找不到工作到处游荡，最先头疼的可就是居委会了。

    子女顶替的制度在五十年代就有了，刚开始是为了鼓励年老体衰职工安心退休，可以由子女接班顶替。六十年代因为众所周知的原因被终止，73年率先在矿山井下、野外勘探、森林采伐和盐业这“四大行业”得以恢复。

    这四个行业苦啊…

    后世网上经常骂电二代、烟二代，谁听说过骂地质二代？能在大山和戈壁从事勘探的二代，那妥妥的坚强战士啊！

    1978年6月，该规定正式颁布，允许一家有一个子女接班顶替。直到86年开始废止，90年代明令禁止。但一二十年以来形成的惯性，那可不是一纸文书就能轻易改变的。
content_en:
"Then we have to wait until you become a division-level cadre!" Wang Aimei shook the water on her chopsticks, "Our family's conditions are not as good as those above, but more than below. You should be your soldier and don't think of any evil ways. Your father was very happy when you saved someone last time and told everyone you met."

    Liu Zhenguo walked in and said with a smile: "As if you didn't go out to shout, your mother has a louder voice than me."

    "Eat your food!" Wang Aimei glared at Liu Zhenguo and said loudly.

    At noon, Wang Aimei made noodles, potato and egg stew, and pickles bought from Liubiju. Braised, that is, toppings. When eating noodles, pour the marinade on the noodles, stir them and eat them directly.

    They came to Yanjing, but their eating habits have not changed.

    Liu Zhenguo praised the food a few times, which made Wang Aimei very happy. Then he asked Liu Jimin about his recent academic status.

    When it comes to studying, Liu Zhenguo gets a headache. He knows that his kid studying medicine is just trying to catch up, and the key is that he has no talent.

    "Well, if it doesn't work out, after returning to the army, just mention it to your superiors and join the combat company directly. If the doctor is not good at academics, big trouble will happen." Liu Zhenguo said helplessly, thinking that it would be better if he could be sent to a water conservancy university, and he could inherit his father's career.

    Being a hygienist is relatively easy, but being a military doctor is not just a job.

    "It is still necessary to stay in the army. It is too difficult to find a job when we return home. Recently, many educated youths have returned to the city, and there are too many young people who are unemployed. It is difficult to arrange it! The superiors intend to trial a job promotion system, allowing a child of a retired employee to take over. Before the trial has started, some families are already quarreling. The collective units have broken their heads to get in, and this is only part of the return. If they all come back, the work of the neighborhood committee will be difficult."

    Wang Aimei frowned and said, her eyes full of worry. A large number of young people cannot find jobs and are wandering around. The first headache is for the neighborhood committees.

    The system of child replacement has been around since the 1950s. It was originally intended to encourage elderly and frail workers to retire peacefully and allow their children to take over. It was terminated in the 1960s due to well-known reasons. In 1973, it took the lead in resuming the "four major industries" of underground mines, field exploration, forest logging and salt industry.

    These four industries are miserable...

    Later generations often criticize the second generation of electricity and second generation cigarettes on the Internet. Who has ever heard of scolding the second generation of geology? The second generation who can engage in exploration in the mountains and the Gobi are truly strong warriors!

    In June 1978, this regulation was officially promulgated, allowing a family to have one child to take over. It was not abolished until 1986 and was banned in the 1990s. But the inertia formed over the past ten or twenty years cannot be easily changed with a piece of paper.
